statements.t: Meeting with the FDA scheduled for the first quarter of 2027 to discuss the Company’s proposed clinical development plan for ARD-101; Company expects to resume PWS clinical activities in 2027
“We have developed a proposed clinical development plan and look forward to discussing it with the FDA.
The Company intends to provide further details on the development pathway following FDA feedback.
The Company expects to resume PWS clinical activities in 2027, subject to alignment with the FDA.

risks.t: various important factors, including: the risk that the FDA may not agree with Aardvark’s proposed Phase 3 program or may require additional studies
the risk that the timing of Aardvark’s meeting with the FDA may be delayed
the timing of resuming dosing and activating clinical sites
uncertainties related to potential delays in the commencement, enrollment and completion of clinical trials
the risk of additional safety findings, including risks related to cardiac safety and drug-drug interactions
the risk of unfavorable clinical trial results
the risk that results from earlier clinical trials and preclinical studies may not necessarily be predictive of future results
Aardvark’s ability to raise sufficient capital to fund its planned Phase 3 program
the possibility that the past track records of Aardvark and its personnel may not be repeated or indicative of future success
Aardvark’s ability to obtain, maintain and enforce intellectual property protection for ARD-101
Aardvark’s ability to retain key personnel following its June 2026 workforce reduction
general economic, market and industry conditions
